item.title: Network Security & Cybersecurity: Threat modeling, access control, encryption, and defensive posture
item.description:
Studying defensive security paradigms, cryptographic standards, packet filtering, firewall configurations, and vulnerability assessments.
Architecture Focus: Zero-Trust Verification, Threat Modeling & Defensive Controls Key Topics: Defensive Network Perimeter & Packet Filtering • Transport Layer Security (TLS) Handshake Decryption • API Security: Prevention of Injection, CSRF, and Broken Auth • Vulnerability Surface Scanning & Hardening Protocols: SSL/TLS, Firewalls / iptables, PKI & Cryptography, OWASP Top 10, Access Control (RBAC)
Code Implementation (bash): curl -sI https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app/api/health | grep -iE '(strict-transport|x-frame|content-security)' openssl s_client -connect yeasin-sec.vercel.app:443 -tls1_3

item.title: [LAB-SEC-02] REST API Authentication & Header Security Audit
item.description:
Evaluating backend endpoints against missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), improper CORS policies, and token leakage.
Domain: Defensive Security | Status: Active Lab Tools: Postman, Node.js, JWT Inspector, cURL Key Takeaway: Standardized defensive header practices and token expiration lifecycles on backend microservices.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): curl -i -X OPTIONS https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/api/contact \ -H "Origin: https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app" \ -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: [LAB-SYS-03] Linux Server Hardening & SSH Key Enforcement
item.description:
Configuring non-root administrative users, enforcing Ed25519 SSH keys, disabling password authentication, and setting up basic UFW firewall rules.
Domain: System Hardening | Status: Active Lab Tools: Ubuntu Server, SSH (Ed25519), UFW / iptables, systemd Key Takeaway: Minimized attack surface on Linux hosts by restricting open ports and eliminating brute-force vectors.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): sudo ufw default deny incoming sudo ufw default allow outgoing sudo ufw allow OpenSSH sudo ufw enable && sudo ufw status verbose
